page.title: 1. Conception & Context
page.description: Transform an idea into a versioned, reviewable product definition before execution begins.

wizard.updateFromDiagramEmpty: The entity and functionality diagram is still empty -- open the System Map to start modeling.

context.help: Paste a loose context document (an idea for a system, an automation, or a service) and have an agent draft the fields below from it -- review and adjust before saving. Regenerate as many times as you like.
context.contextPlaceholder: Paste or write the loose context here...
context.uploadNoAgent: Select an agent below to upload and summarize a file.
context.copyPrompt: Copy the prompt (what the agent expects from the context)
context.appliedHint: Documentation draft ready -- see it in Step 6 (Documentation).

documentation.help: Attach markdown reference material or fill-in templates for this concept -- upload a file or write a new one, then edit it inline.
documentation.saveFirst: Save this idea first (Create conception) before attaching documents.
documentation.selectHint: Select a file on the left, or upload/create one.

description.help: Describe the system in plain language and, if the code already exists, point to its working directory -- this description feeds the entity and functionality diagram in the next steps.

stack.help: Add the technologies this project actually uses, picking from the organization's architecture standards -- not every project needs every layer, and some need more than one entry per layer. This is recorded on the concept and feeds the Tech Spec once the concept is approved. "Generate with agent" proposes a stack grounded in help/TECH_STACK_GUIDE.md and the current catalog instead of a free-form suggestion.
stack.generateNoAgent: Select an agent above (Step 1) to generate the stack.

captureIdea.title: Capture idea
captureIdea.description: This creates a concept product and its first System Map revision.
captureIdea.conceptLocked: The concept was already submitted for review, so the problem statement, vision and initial scope can no longer be edited here. Name, requester, project description, working directory and tech stack remain editable.

error.createFailed: The idea could not be created. Check for a duplicate name.

developmentRequests.title: Development requests
developmentRequests.description: Intake and conversion trace for product creation.

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes the product, its concept, System Map and every related revision. This cannot be undone.

conceptDecision.title: Concept decision
conceptDecision.description: Execution remains blocked until concept and map are approved.

error.submitBlocked: Submission was blocked. Validate the System Map and your command permission.

authorizeForm.tasksGenerated: {{count}} task(s) generated in the Backlog from this scope.
